scope.details: Six historically explored Kang development donors with overlapping TRAIN sets; three coupled SAE/adapter seeds, not 18 independent donors. PBMC is one historically explored 4,638-cell file; independent donor/study/pretraining status unknown. Missing and tiny class supports limit interpretation.

adapter_and_loss.details: Signed raw-value TopK cache replay passes on 792 independently selected rows. Full raw h skip is present; zero residual initialization and two-step gradient flow verified. SupCon matches explicit-loop duplicate/cross-donor masks. Rotation preserves sampled Gram and all dictionary-column norms.

capacity_and_budget.details: Gate/rotated gate match at 2,048 adapter parameters; lowrank/MLP match at 40,960. Gate-vs-MLP is not parameter matched. All adapter arms share 3 beta candidates, common head and upper epoch budget; early stopping differs. This does not establish optimal tuning for every architecture.
